Claire — quick technical notes ahead of the walkthrough so we can move faster on the call:

- Pinecone: supported. For production we recommend float32 vectors for initial runs; if you're using an ANN quantized index we can accept quantized payloads but will need the quantization params.
- Weaviate: supported via semantic vector ingestion; ensure schema includes "document_id" and a stable text->id mapping for priming.
- Archival S3 store: we can run a staged backfill that rehydrates top-K candidates into your active index — this is our recommended approach for large, cold archives.

Backfill strategy suggestion (high level):
- Wave 0 (seed): 10k high-recall priming records sampled from production traffic (random stratified by query bucket)
- Wave 1: 100k incremental append (continuous priming)
- Wave 2: bulk backfill for remaining historical docs (throttled)

Sampling guidance: for rerank evals, 10k queries should be sufficient for an initial quality signal; aim for stratified sampling across top-traffic intents.

I've uploaded an ACME compatibility matrix for the flows referenced here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyExampleDriveLink and attached acme-compatibility-matrix.csv with recommended schema mappings.

See you on the call — I'll bring the priming playbook and the backfill cost estimate.

— Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks all — adding the rerank evaluation angle here. Key points: 

- Eval fixture: use a held-out set of ~10k queries with human relevance labels (if available) or annotated proxies.
- Metrics: MRR@10, NDCG@10, and a manual pass for hallucination/regression checks on a sampled 200 queries.
- Acceptance: target +8% MRR improvement over current baseline in pilot mode, with <2% user-facing latency regression.

Attached: rerank-eval-template.csv (format for labels + scoring). I'll create SUP-1782 for tracking the smoke test and link it to the pilot milestone.

Timeline (proposed):
- Dev smoke tests: 2027-08-23
- Pilot (limited traffic): 2027-09-06
- Full cutover: 2027-09-27

I'll post the JIRA after the call.

— Priyom Das
Applied ML Engineer
